You must be a student registered in a Canadian College or University. This position is for students returning to school after their work term or requiring a placement as requirements for graduation. While not required, preference will be given to students enrolled in a registered Co-op program. Applicants are required to submit both their resume and their most recent unofficial transcript as part of the application process. We are looking for an AI Governance & Reporting Intern to join the Canada Life Data, AI Automation & Platforms team to help us operationalize responsible AI and AI enablement across Canada Life. What You'll Do • • Governance & Compliance Maintain the AI use?case inventory and lifecycle records across intake, review, approvals, and monitoring. • Triage AI use-cases and ensure adherence to AI policies/standards (privacy, security, legal, etc.) • Support governance forums and prepare briefing materials for the AI Review Group • Reporting, Dashboard and Automation • Build and automate dashboards (e.g., in Power BI) showing AI use-case throughput and AI use case assessment lifecycle • Produce executive?level summaries -clear narratives, visuals, and call?outs on trends, risks, and decisions needed. • Create automated reporting flows using Power Automate (notifications, SLA reminders, approvals tracking) • Data Analysis • Synthesize input from Architecture, Legal, Privacy, Risk, and Responsible AI reviews to build integrated reports • Analyze trends in AI adoption, tools, and KPI reporting • Process Enablement • Improve and maintain governance templates, checklists, and SharePoint content. • Support continuous improvement of the AI governance workflow and stakeholder experience • Stakeholder Collaboration • Work with cross?functional teams across Canada Life to ensure alignment on standards, controls, and reporting cadences. Partner with global and local teams working on AI, automation, analytics and reporting • What You'll Be Working With • Power BI (advanced proficiency expected) - designing executive dashboards • Power Automate - designing automated approval flows, reminders, and data refresh triggers • Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint • Jira, Confluence, LeanIX MS Copilot Chat, Studio and CoPilot reporting • Why Join Us • Learn how a large financial institution enable and governs AI responsibly. • Build executive?level reporting and analytical skills with real impact. • Work alongside experts in AI, Data, Architecture, Privacy, and Risk • Contribute to real initiatives that shape how AI is evaluated and deployed at Canada Life • Gain experience with tooling (Power BI, Automate, MS CoPilot, governance platforms) Accelerate your career in AI policy, tech governance, analytics, or risk management • The base salary for this position is between $48,000 - $71,900 annually. This represents base salary only and does not represent other variable compensation components of our total compensation ( i.e. annual bonus, commission etc).
